scene: You step from the gondola drone onto a bustling canal promenade.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a cobbled quay. On far left, a glassblower's stall glows with figurines. Left-centre stands the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit holding her dog's leash, beside the hovering gondola drone. In the centre, a masked cat-costumed reveller holds a lantern. On far right, an arched stone bridge crosses the canal.
shown: a glow-glass display stall on the far left with spun glass figures
a masked reveller dressed as an ornate cat in the centre
a stone arched bridge spanning water on the far right
